title: Table display with a wooden wind-tunnel model and project poster by a glass stairwell
objects_and_counts: At least 3 people are visible: one person seated at the table with their back to the camera wearing a white shirt (central foreground), one partially visible person standing at right holding a laptop (right edge, torso and hands visible), and at least one reflected person visible in the glass behind the poster on the staircase (upper left region).
One large wooden box assembly that appears to be a model wind tunnel or duct is placed horizontally on the table spanning most of the image width (central and left regions).
One poster board mounted vertically behind the wooden assembly (centre background) with multiple panels and headings.
One small rectangular sign reading 'Project 06' with a blue panel below reading 'VOTE' and a thumbs-up icon, placed on the right edge of the wooden assembly (right of centre).
One laptop computer is visible and in use by the person at the right edge of the image (right edge, partially cropped).
One gray seat/chair is visible near the right foreground (lower right).
One white table supports the wooden assembly and objects (full-width foreground).
Two green plastic crates are visible stacked under the table near centre-right; the top crate is partly obscured by the table surface (under centre-right of table).
One short stack of metal rectangular beams or profiles is visible on the table under the wooden assembly near centre (under centre of table and visible through gaps).
One circular object is visible inside the clear viewing window cut into the wooden assembly (central front of wooden model).
One red cable or wire runs from the right end of the wooden assembly down toward the floor (right foreground).
One small notice sign is affixed to the glass behind and left of the poster (centre background, lower part of glass).
visible_text: FLY ON THE GROUND! - HKU's 1st USER-FRIENDLY WIND TUNNEL
spatial_relations: The wooden wind-tunnel assembly sits horizontally on a white table that spans the lower portion of the image; its long axis is roughly left-to-right across the frame.
The poster board is mounted or standing directly behind the wooden assembly and is centred in the background; the poster is adjacent to and visually above the central opening of the wooden model.
The seated person in a white shirt is positioned directly in front of the central opening of the wooden assembly, facing it and the poster, with their back to the camera (foreground centre).
The 'Project 06 / VOTE' sign is attached at the right end of the wooden assembly, to the viewer's right of the poster.
Green plastic crates are stacked under the table near the centre-right under the wooden assembly, partially supporting or stored beneath the work surface.
A glass wall with a staircase behind it forms the background; reflections of at least one person appear in the glass and the staircase with mint-green panels is visible behind the poster.
A laptop user stands at the right edge of the image, holding a laptop beside the table and to the right of the wooden assembly and chair.
colours_and_materials: The large model is made from plywood or a wood-like brown material with visible grain and joins; one end shows red tape or a red-painted edge on the right side.
The poster board background appears dark grey with white heading text at the top and lighter grey panels for section headings.
The table surface is white; the chair visible at right is grey plastic or painted material.
The stacked crates under the table are green plastic with black stenciled or printed lettering (partly obscured and upside down in view).
The background features a glass partition (transparent) and a staircase with mint-green or pale green frosted glass panels and metallic handrails.
uncertainties: Exact text lines under the poster headings are largely unreadable at this resolution; only the poster's main headline and section headings are legible.
The small notice sign on the glass is only partially legible: 'NOTICE' is clear but the remainder of that sign's text is unreadable from this image and transcribed as [unreadable].
Text on the green plastic crates is partly visible but upside down and not fully legible; the reading of departmental text is uncertain and therefore not transcribed.
There are reflections in the glass that show additional people or figures on the staircase; it is unclear whether those are separate people or duplicates/reflections of people present elsewhere.

Some small equipment or labels on the table beneath the wooden assembly are obscured by the seated person and/or the assembly so counts or label transcriptions for those items cannot be determined from this image.
